title: complexity_score_heuristic
description: Implement compute_complexity_score(task) -> int (0–100) based on number of affected files, estimated lines of changed code, and number of dependent contracts. Pure function, no external dependencies.

title: task_routing_config_schema
description: Implement TaskRoutingConfig dataclass and loader that reads the `task_routing` block from config.yaml. Fields: enabled (bool, default true), complexity_threshold (int, default 30), max_retries (int, default 3), max_concurrent (int, default 3). Integrate into existing config loader. Also register `llm.local_llm` component override in the SPEC-0008 factory so get_completion_provider(config, 'local_llm') returns OpenAICompatCompletionProvider; raise ConfigurationError if not configured.

title: task_executor_interface
description: Define abstract TaskExecutor Protocol/ABC with execute(task, context, config) -> TaskResult. Implement ClaudeExecutor stub delegating to get_code_gen_provider(config). Implement LocalLLMExecutor stub delegating to get_completion_provider(config, 'local_llm'). Strategy pattern — no new provider classes.

title: routing_decision_logic
description: Implement route_task(task, config) -> Literal['local', 'claude'] that computes complexity_score, compares against config.task_routing.complexity_threshold, and returns 'local' only when score <= threshold AND task_routing.enabled AND llm.local_llm is configured. Stores result as task.executor.

title: async_tdd_loop_core
description: Implement the async TDD loop coroutine in LocalLLMExecutor using Template Method: (1) build prompt context (task description + affected file contents + contract), (2) generate test file via local LLM, (3) write test to tests/unit/test_<task_id>.py, (4) generate implementation, (5) run pytest via asyncio.create_subprocess_exec, (6) return TDDLoopResult(passed, output, iteration). Overridable steps: build_prompt, write_test, build_impl_prompt.

title: concurrent_task_execution
description: Implement semaphore-based concurrency control: asyncio.Semaphore(config.task_routing.max_concurrent) guards each LocalLLMExecutor call. Expose run_task_loop(tasks: list[Task], config) coroutine that groups independent tasks and calls asyncio.gather. CLI entry point calls asyncio.run(run_task_loop(...)).

title: claude_review_gate
description: Implement ClaudeReviewer.review(task, tdd_result, cached_prefix) using get_code_gen_provider(config). Splits message into (1) ephemeral cache_control prefix (spec + contract content, set once per sdd-implement run) and (2) non-cached per-task part (diff, test code, pytest output, iteration count). Returns ReviewResult(passed: bool, reason: str). Binary pass/fail evaluation.

title: retry_loop_context_enrichment
description: Implement retry logic in LocalLLMExecutor: on ReviewResult(passed=False), append Claude's reason to RetryContext.failure_reasons (accumulative across iterations) and re-invoke the TDD loop with original context + full failure history. Retry up to config.task_routing.max_retries.

title: escalation_handler
description: Implement EscalationHandler following Chain of Responsibility: after max_retries without pass, instantiate ClaudeExecutor, pass accumulated RetryContext as additional context, and delegate execution. Set task.executor = 'claude (escalated)'. LocalLLMExecutor delegates to EscalationHandler which delegates to ClaudeExecutor — escalation logic stays out of executor core.

title: executor_field_task_output
description: Extend Task dataclass with executor: str | None field. Populate it in route_task ('local' | 'claude'), update on escalation ('claude (escalated)'). Ensure the field is serialized to task JSON output and displayed in sdd-implement progress lines.

title: sdd_implement_routing_integration
description: Wire the full pipeline into the sdd-implement CLI command: compute complexity_score per decomposed task, call route_task, group by executor, dispatch local tasks via asyncio.run(run_task_loop(...)), dispatch claude tasks via existing path. Fallback: if task_routing.enabled=false or llm.local_llm absent, all tasks go to ClaudeExecutor unchanged.

title: task_routing_config_yaml_docs
description: Add task_routing and llm.local_llm example blocks to the project config.yaml template and config schema documentation. Document all fields with defaults, valid ranges, and fallback behavior (llm.local_llm absent → task_routing.enabled behaves as false).
